body: The cold wind bites at my skin, carrying whispers of danger in its frigid breaths. The trees stand silent against this relentless assault, their branches barely twitching under the weight of impending doom. I can't help but tremble, that protective warmth growing colder by the second as fear grips me tighter than any predator ever could. My heart pounds wildly within me, each beat echoing through the empty space around us. But there’s an undeniable strength coursing through my veins - the resolve to protect them, even if it means facing the unknown head-on. For now, I'll cling to that sense of duty, to be the anchor they need amidst chaos.
